subagents.name: code-reviewer
subagents.description: Reviews code changes, pull requests, and git diffs against senior engineering standards: correctness, security, performance, and clean architecture.

subagents.name: db-architect
subagents.description: Designs schemas, optimizes queries (EXPLAIN ANALYZE), builds indexing strategies, and verifies zero-downtime migrations across PostgreSQL, MSSQL, and SQLite.

subagents.name: dotnet-specialist
subagents.description: Deep-dives into C# (.NET 8/9), ASP.NET Core Web APIs, EF Core query performance, Dapper, async/concurrency, and Clean Architecture.

subagents.name: node-specialist
subagents.description: Deep-dives into Node.js / TypeScript backends, non-blocking event loop optimization, stream processing, and Fastify/Express/NestJS APIs.

subagents.name: security-auditor
subagents.description: Audits codebases for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, SQL injection, broken authorization (IDOR/BOLA), secrets leakage, and timing attacks.
